---
title: "Audio transcription"
---

Install whisper.cpp for local transcription of audio and video.
FFmpeg converts the input inside the official whisper.cpp Docker image; transcription runs on demand and writes a text file next to the input.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags whisper
```

The role pulls the image and downloads the checksummed default model to `~/.local/share/whisper/models`. It also installs `transcribe` in `~/.local/bin`, available from any project directory.

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
command -v transcribe
transcribe --help
test -s ~/.local/share/whisper/models/ggml-base.en.bin
docker image inspect ghcr.io/ggerganov/whisper.cpp:main
```

Expected: `transcribe` is on `PATH`, help text is displayed, the model file is present, and Docker recognizes the image.
:::

## Usage

Run `transcribe` from any directory. The helper accepts audio/video formats supported by the image's FFmpeg and writes `<input-stem>.txt` alongside the input.

```sh
transcribe presentation.mp4
transcribe recording.wav
transcribe "interview recording.mp3"
```

For example, `presentation.mp4` produces `presentation.txt` in the same directory. Existing text files are never silently replaced. Pass `--overwrite` to replace one deliberately:

```sh
transcribe presentation.mp4 --overwrite
```

The helper copies the source to a private temporary directory, converts its audio to mono 16 kHz 16-bit PCM WAV, runs `/app/build/bin/whisper-cli` in Docker, and removes temporary files even if conversion or inference fails. The original file is only read. The final output is created by the invoking user.

## Models and languages

The default model is `base.en` and the default language is English. Select an installed model or language with:

```sh
transcribe presentation.mp4 --model base.en
transcribe interview.mp4 --language de
```

`--model` selects `ggml-<name>.bin` from `~/.local/share/whisper/models` (or the configured model directory). The role installs its configured model; other models must first be provisioned into that same directory. To have Ansible install another model, set `whisper_model_name` and the corresponding verified `whisper_model_sha256` when running the `whisper` tag. The default model checksum is checked on every run, so an incomplete or altered download is repaired and a valid model is not downloaded again.

| Model | Approx. size | Trade-off |
|--|---:|---------|
| `tiny.en` | 75 MB | Fast and small, with lower accuracy on difficult speech. |
| `base.en` | 148 MB | Default balance of speed, accuracy, and memory for English. |
| `small.en` | 466 MB | Usually more accurate, with more memory use and slower inference. |
| `base` / `small` | varies | Multilingual; use these rather than `.en` models for non-English speech. |

Larger models can improve recognition of accents, noisy recordings, and specialized vocabulary, but use more memory and take longer. The `.en` models are English-only; choose a multilingual model for another language. The `--language` option accepts Whisper language codes such as `en`, `de`, and `fr`, or `auto`.

## Troubleshooting

- **`Docker could not start`**: confirm the Docker service is running and your user can access it. After first-time Docker installation, log out and back in.
- **`model ... is not installed`**: rerun the `whisper` Ansible tag with that model configured, and confirm the corresponding `ggml-<name>.bin` exists in the configured model directory.
- **FFmpeg conversion failed**: check that the file is readable and contains an audio stream supported by FFmpeg. Video is used only as a source of audio; visual content is not analyzed.
- **Output already exists**: choose another input name or pass `--overwrite` to replace the existing transcription.
- **Language results are poor**: use the correct `--language` and a multilingual model for non-English audio. An English-only `.en` model is not suitable for other languages.

## Privacy and best practices

The recording is processed locally by FFmpeg and whisper.cpp in Docker. It is not uploaded to an external transcription service. The container receives only a temporary staged copy and the read-only model directory; SELinux-aware private volume labels are used for the mounts. Docker and model downloads require network access during setup, but transcription itself does not send recordings over the network.

Review the resulting text, especially names, numbers, accents, and technical terminology. Keep the original recording if it is needed for verification.
